title: San Diego, It's Time to Sleigh.
description:
We’re just 3 days away from December Nights! ✨🎄It’s time to sleigh the season with the City of San Diego’s largest free holiday celebration. 

Join us on Friday, Dec. 5 from 3 –11 p.m. and Saturday, Dec. 6 from 11 a.m. - 11 p.m. Get ready for lights, music, food, and festive fun for the whole family. Who’s coming? 🎁 
#DecemberNights2025 #SanDiego
